checklist.step: Scope the annual notice audit and issue the planning memo
actions: Open the engagement in AuditBoard under the annual plan and write the planning memo: objective (notice content and timing accuracy under NAIC 74), period covered, notice types in scope, and the matrix version supplying the test criteria.
Review the prior year's findings, the C05 complaint trends and any C02/C03 exceptions to weight the risk areas.
Set the milestone dates: fieldwork window, draft date, management-response due date (draft + 20 business days) and final issuance.
Have the Chief Audit Executive approve the memo before fieldwork.
checklist.done: an approved planning memo fixes objective, period, criteria version, risk weighting and milestones.

checklist.step: Notify stakeholders and agree evidence logistics
actions: Send the engagement notification to the Policy Admin Ops Lead, Compliance Manager and Market Conduct / Consumer Compliance Manager with the evidence request list and dates.
Agree read access to the notice log, the correspondence engine archive and the compliance evidence repository rather than accepting curated extracts.
Record the evidence request list and access grants in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: stakeholders are notified and the audit holds direct read access to the source systems.

checklist.step: Pull the notice population independently from source
actions: Extract the audit-period notice population from the C02 notice log and, independently, the provider network change feed archive so unnoticed events enter the population.
Extract the correspondence engine's send history for the same period as a third source.
Reconcile the three sources and carry differences into fieldwork as potential completeness findings.
Freeze the population with row counts by state and notice type in the workpaper.
checklist.done: a three-source reconciled population is frozen with counts by state and notice type.

checklist.step: Obtain the audit criteria pack
actions: Obtain the counsel-verified matrix version named in the planning memo, the C01 form inventory as of the period, and the C03 rule-table baseline exports.
Build the per-state criteria sheet the testers will score against: required content elements, day count, basis and approved template version by period.
Have the Compliance Analyst confirm the criteria sheet faithfully reflects the matrix — the audit tests against the law, not against operations' own settings.
checklist.done: a compliance-confirmed criteria sheet exists per state covering content, timing and template versions.

checklist.step: Design the stratified sample
actions: Stratify by notice type × state; cover every notice type and at least 10 jurisdictions, always including Alaska (representative state) and any state with a period complaint cluster or prior-year finding.
Take 100% of short-fuse and breach-escalated events and a seeded random draw from the remainder to a minimum of 60 notices.
Record seed, strata, population counts and selection date so the sample is reproducible.
Size the judgemental additions separately so statistical and judgemental items are never mixed in one conclusion.
checklist.done: a reproducible stratified sample of ≥60 notices covers all types, ≥10 states and all adverse events.

checklist.step: Re-test notice content against the criteria sheet
actions: Retrieve each sampled notice's rendered specimen from the evidence repository and score every required content element for the member's state: present, altered or missing.
Verify the specimen's template id and version were the approved C01 inventory version current on the mail date.
Check merge data against source: provider name, termination effective date, alternative providers and day counts as stated to the member.
Record element-level results in the AuditBoard testing matrix with the specimen attached.
checklist.done: every sampled notice has element-level content scores on the correct-version check with specimens attached.

checklist.step: Recompute the timing on every sampled notice
actions: Recompute the mail-by date from the event effective date and the state's day count on the criteria sheet, honouring calendar/business-day basis.
Compare to the actual mail date on the vendor manifest — not the notice log's SLA flag.
Re-judge 'as soon as practicable' cases against receipt date + 5 business days.
Record days early/late per notice; any late notice is a finding regardless of the log's own verdict.
checklist.done: every sampled notice has an independently recomputed timing result taken from manifest dates.

checklist.step: Trace delivery evidence for the sample
actions: Trace each sampled notice to its mail manifest or e-delivery receipt, and for 15 notices trace the individual member onto the manifest detail.
Verify returned-mail items show the logged cure attempt within the 5-business-day standard.
Verify the notice log row is locked and any corrections trace to correction rows.
checklist.done: sampled notices trace to member-level delivery evidence with cures verified and log integrity intact.

checklist.step: Test the completeness gap directly
actions: Work every population-reconciliation difference from the three-source pull: feed events with no notice, engine sends with no log row, log rows with no event.
Classify each as a genuine miss, a timing artifact or a data defect, with evidence.
Any genuine unnoticed event is a severity-1 finding routed immediately to the Compliance Officer for the C02 cure process — before the report, not with it.
checklist.done: every reconciliation difference is classified with evidence and genuine misses are cured-routed immediately.

checklist.step: Document findings with severity and member exposure
actions: Write each finding in AuditBoard: condition, criteria (the state cite), cause, effect and member exposure count.
Rate severity on the audit methodology scale, with unnoticed events and content omissions of statutory elements rated highest.
Cross-reference each finding to the workpaper evidence and the affected states.
Review all findings with the Audit Analyst who tested them before leaving fieldwork.
checklist.done: every finding is written with condition-criteria-cause-effect, severity, exposure and evidence links.

checklist.step: Clear the facts with management before drafting
actions: Walk each finding's facts with the Policy Admin Ops Lead and Compliance Manager and correct any factual error against evidence.
Do not negotiate severity — facts are agreed, ratings belong to Audit.
Record the fact-clearance meeting and outcomes in AuditBoard.
checklist.done: facts are cleared and recorded with severity ratings unchanged by negotiation.

checklist.step: Issue the draft and collect management responses
actions: Issue the draft report to the Head of Compliance, Policy Admin Ops Lead and Head of IT with responses due in 20 business days.
Require each response to name a remediation owner, action and date; reject 'noted' responses.
Load each remediation as a tracked action in AuditBoard with its due date.
checklist.done: every finding carries an owned, dated management response loaded for tracking.

checklist.step: Issue the final report to governance
actions: Review the final report, sign it and issue to the Audit Committee and the Head of Compliance.
Present the overall opinion and the severity-1 findings at the next Audit Committee sitting.
File the final report in AuditBoard and mirror to the compliance evidence repository under REG-036/C06.
checklist.done: the signed final report is issued, presented to the Audit Committee and filed in both repositories.

checklist.step: Route compliance breaches into the operational cure and tracker
actions: Log each audit finding as a tracker issue with severity, states and member exposure.
For late or defective notices found, run the C02 cure process including the counsel self-report decision for material breaches.
Link tracker issues to the AuditBoard actions so operational cure and audit remediation close together.
checklist.done: findings exist as tracker issues with cures running and linked closure.

checklist.step: Follow up remediation to verified closure
actions: At each remediation due date, obtain the implementation evidence and re-test a small sample where the fix is systemic (e.g., a corrected rule row per C03).
Close actions only on evidence; escalate items 10 business days overdue to the Chief Audit Executive.
Obtain the Chief Audit Executive's closure sign-off per finding.
Report open-item status quarterly to the Audit Committee until all findings close.
checklist.done: every finding closes on re-tested evidence with CAE sign-off, and overdue items are escalated and reported quarterly.

testing.step: Confirm the audit ran on schedule and to scope
actions: Verify in AuditBoard that the engagement completed within the audit year with the planning memo approved before fieldwork.
Check the scope covered every notice type and ≥10 jurisdictions including Alaska and the complaint-cluster states.
Compare milestone dates achieved against the memo.
testing.done: the engagement is confirmed on-schedule, in-scope and memo-approved before fieldwork.

testing.step: Verify the population was built from source and reconciled
actions: Re-run the notice log and network feed extracts for the audit period and compare row counts to the frozen population workpaper.
Confirm the three-source reconciliation exists and every difference was classified.
A population built only from the notice log — missing the feed side — is a methodology exception.
testing.done: the population re-pull matches the workpaper and the three-source reconciliation is verified.

testing.step: Re-draw the sample from the recorded seed
actions: Re-run the sample selection with the recorded seed and strata against the frozen population.
Confirm the re-draw reproduces the tested sample exactly and the 100% strata (short-fuse, breaches) were fully included.
Confirm the minimum sample size (≥60) was met.
testing.done: the sample reproduces exactly from the seed with mandatory strata complete.

testing.step: Re-perform content testing on a sub-sample
actions: Select 10 of the audited notices (not having been on the engagement) and re-score content elements against the criteria sheet independently.
Compare element-level results to the engagement's testing matrix.
Any scoring difference on a statutory element is a quality exception.
testing.done: independent re-scores match the engagement's results or differences are excepted.

testing.step: Re-perform timing recomputation on a sub-sample
actions: For the same 10 notices, independently recompute mail-by dates from event dates and the criteria sheet and compare to manifest mail dates.
Confirm the engagement took dates from manifests, not from the log's SLA flag.
Verify late notices were all raised as findings.
testing.done: timing re-computations match and every late notice in the sub-sample surfaced as a finding.

testing.step: Verify findings are evidence-backed and correctly rated
actions: Read every finding and trace its condition statement to the linked workpaper evidence.
Check severity ratings against the methodology scale, particularly that unnoticed events and missing statutory elements carry the top rating.
Check member exposure counts trace to the population data.
testing.done: every finding traces to evidence with methodology-consistent ratings and supported exposure counts.

testing.step: Verify severity-1 items were cure-routed during fieldwork
actions: For each severity-1 finding, verify the tracker issue and the C02 cure actions started before report issuance, not after.
Verify the counsel self-report decision is documented for material breaches.
Late routing of a severity-1 item is itself an exception.
testing.done: severity-1 findings show cure actions and counsel decisions pre-dating the final report.

testing.step: Verify management responses and remediation tracking
actions: Check every finding has an owned, dated management response received within the 20-business-day window.
Check closed actions carry implementation evidence and re-test results where systemic.
Check overdue actions were escalated at 10 business days and reported to the Audit Committee quarterly.
testing.done: responses, evidence-based closures and escalations all verify against the program's rules.

testing.step: Log quality exceptions with root cause, owner and remediation date
actions: Raise one issue per quality exception: scope shortfall, population gap, irreproducible sample, unsupported finding, late cure routing.
Assign root cause and an owner within the audit function, with methodology fixes fed into next year's program.
Set remediation dates and carry open items into next year's quality review.
testing.done: every quality exception has an issue, root cause, owner, date and a program-improvement action.

testing.step: Conclude and sign the quality review
actions: Conclude whether the annual audit obligation was met: on schedule, in scope, reproducible, evidence-backed and remediation-tracked.
Write the quality-review memo with the conclusion and exception list.
Sign as reviewer, having performed none of the engagement fieldwork, and file the memo in AuditBoard mirrored to the compliance evidence repository under REG-036/C06.
testing.done: a signed quality-review memo with a stated conclusion is filed in both repositories.
